title: Zero to your first 1,000
when: You are starting a channel or account and want a plan you can actually finish.
summary: Intake, positioning, voice, profile, research, first batch of content, a four-week calendar, and a day-30 review. One hub platform first.

steps.title: Run the intake
steps.do: Answer what you are making, who it is for, where, and why. Confirm the hub, the spokes and the weekly load.

steps.title: Write the promise and the pillars
steps.do: One sentence on who you help and how. Three content pillars. A list of things about you that are provable.

steps.title: Capture your voice
steps.do: Paste or upload 3 to 5 things you wrote or said. Build voice notes every later draft will use.

steps.title: Set up the hub profile
steps.do: Score the hub profile, then rewrite name, bio, link and pinned content in fix-first order.

steps.title: Study what works in your niche
steps.do: Pick 5 to 10 accounts. List the topics and formats that recur. Note the gaps.

steps.title: Rank outliers
steps.do: Collect 10 to 20 posts by hand or from exports, then rank them by multiple over each account's median.

steps.title: Build the idea bank
steps.do: Generate and score 30 ideas across the pillars. Pick the first 6.

steps.title: Write the hooks
steps.do: Three hooks per chosen idea, scored. Keep the best, cut anything with a dealbreaker.

steps.title: Script the first batch
steps.do: Script and time the first three to six pieces. Fix every beat flag before filming.

steps.title: Package it
steps.do: Captions, titles and thumbnail text. Check the preview window on each platform.

steps.title: Clean and check
steps.do: Run the humanizer, then the policy check for originality, disclosure and claims.

steps.title: Lay out four weeks
steps.do: Build the calendar inside your real hours. Export to your calendar app.

steps.title: Publish week one
steps.do: You post. Nothing here posts for you. Note the time you posted each piece.

steps.title: Run the engagement routine
steps.do: Fifteen minutes a day: comments on ten accounts in your niche, replies on your own posts, one useful DM.

steps.title: Week-one numbers
steps.do: Export the numbers for your first posts. Read them against each other, not against anyone else.

steps.title: Choose one thing to test
steps.do: Pick a single variable for weeks two and three. Write the hypothesis before you post.

steps.title: Run two weekly sprints
steps.do: Start the weekly-sprint playbook twice. Same cadence, one variable changed.

steps.title: Day-30 review
steps.do: Run the monthly-review playbook. Decide: keep the hub, change the format, add a spoke, or cut one.
